# Hounsfield Lab

> A directory of open-source and downloadable software for medical AI development, curated by a practicing neuroradiologist. Radiology-first, plus pathology, clinical NLP and EHR tooling. 48 tools. Repository data snapshot: 2026-10-13. Also a directory of 62 public DICOM and NIfTI imaging datasets.

Badges: LIC = license (license files reviewed by hand where GitHub could not detect them); UPD = last repository push (UTC); STATUS = Maintained if updated within 12 months of the snapshot, else Stale; COMM = Permissive, Copyleft (GPL/AGPL), Non-commercial, or Verify (custom terms or separate model-weight terms). Not legal or medical advice.

## Pages

- [Directory](https://hounsfieldlab.com/directory.html): filterable list of all tools
- [DICOM datasets](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets.html): public imaging datasets with license, access, and normals
- [Pipeline guide](https://hounsfieldlab.com/pipeline-orthanc-mercure.html): Orthanc → mercure → TotalSegmentator → OHIF
- [About](https://hounsfieldlab.com/about.html): curation method
- [Full catalog for LLMs](https://hounsfieldlab.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Catalog JSON](https://hounsfieldlab.com/data/catalog.json)
- [Dataset JSON](https://hounsfieldlab.com/data/datasets.json)

## Foundation models & agents

- [Pillar-0 (finetune code + HF weights)](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pillar-0.html): Open 3D radiology foundation model; finetuning framework, weights on Hugging Face (ECL-2.0; Maintained)
- [Pillar-0 pretraining](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pillar-0-pretraining.html): Vision-language pretraining code for Pillar-0 (ECL-2.0; Maintained)
- [RATE](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/rate.html): Uses an LLM (Qwen3 via sglang) to extract structured labels for 366 findings from radiology reports (ECL-2.0; Maintained)
- [Merlin](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/merlin.html): 3D vision-language model for CT that uses structured EHR and report supervision (MIT; Maintained)
- [MedGemma](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medgemma.html): Google's open medical model family; repo has notebooks and code (Apache-2.0 (code); Maintained)
- [CheXagent](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/chexagent.html): Foundation model for chest X-ray interpretation (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; Stale)
- [MedRAX](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medrax.html): Reasoning agent for chest X-rays that orchestrates multiple CXR models (ICML 2025) (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [LLaVA-Med](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/llava-med.html): Biomedical vision-language assistant for image Q&A (Microsoft Research License; Stale)
- [RadKev](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/radkev.html): Open-weight radiology decision models (9B and 27B adapters) that score fixed-choice radiology questions in one forward pass without generating text (Apache-2.0 (code); CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (weights); Maintained)

## Segmentation & frameworks

- [MONAI](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/monai.html): PyTorch-based AI toolkit for healthcare imaging (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [MONAI Label](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/monai-label.html): AI-assisted image labeling and active learning; integrates with 3D Slicer and OHIF (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [nnU-Net](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/nnu-net.html): Self-configuring segmentation framework (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [TotalSegmentator](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/totalsegmentator.html): Segments more than 100 anatomical structures in CT and MR (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [MedSAM](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medsam.html): Segment Anything adapted for medical images (Apache-2.0; Stale)
- [MedSAM2](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medsam2.html): Promptable segmentation of 3D medical images and videos (Apache-2.0; Stale)
- [TorchIO](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/torchio.html): Medical image loading, preprocessing and augmentation for PyTorch (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [PyRadiomics](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pyradiomics.html): Extracts radiomics features from 2D/3D images (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained)
- [ContiLNN](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/contilnn.html): Adds bidirectional liquid-neural modules along the slice axis to 2D restoration backbones; pretrained checkpoints for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution and low-count PET (Apache-2.0; Maintained)

## Neuroimaging

- [HD-BET](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/hd-bet.html): Deep-learning brain extraction (skull stripping) for MRI (Apache-2.0; Stale)
- [BrainChop](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/brainchop.html): In-browser 3D MRI rendering and segmentation (MIT; Maintained)
- [FreeSurfer](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/freesurfer.html): Neuroimaging analysis and visualization suite (FreeSurfer License; Maintained)
- [fMRIPrep](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/fmriprep.html): Robust preprocessing pipeline for fMRI (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [DIPY](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/dipy.html): Python library for diffusion MRI, tractography and registration (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained)
- [nilearn](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/nilearn.html): Machine learning for neuroimaging in Python (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained)
- [ANTsPy](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/antspy.html): Python library for registration, segmentation and analysis (Apache-2.0; Maintained)

## Viewers & toolkits

- [3D Slicer](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/3d-slicer.html): Open platform for visualization, segmentation and image computing (Slicer License (BSD-style); Maintained)
- [OHIF Viewer](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/ohif-viewer.html): Zero-footprint web DICOM viewer (MIT; Maintained)
- [ITK](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/itk.html): C++/Python toolkit for segmentation and registration (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [MITK](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/mitk.html): Medical Imaging Interaction Toolkit for building imaging applications (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained)

## DICOM/PACS & deployment

- [pydicom](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pydicom.html): Read, modify and write DICOM files in Python (MIT (+ noted portions); Maintained)
- [DCMTK](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/dcmtk.html): Comprehensive set of DICOM libraries and tools (C++) (BSD-3-Clause (OFFIS); Maintained)
- [Orthanc](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/orthanc.html): Lightweight DICOM server; this repo builds the Docker images and installers (AGPL-3.0; Maintained)
- [mercure](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/mercure.html): DICOM orchestrator that routes studies to AI processing pipelines (MIT; Maintained)
- [Kaapana](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/kaapana.html): Platform toolkit for medical imaging AI (federated, workflows) (AGPL-3.0; Maintained)

## Pathology

- [TIAToolbox](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/tiatoolbox.html): Computational pathology toolbox: whole-slide image I/O, stain normalization, models (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained)
- [PathML](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pathml.html): Tools for computational pathology (GPL-2.0; Maintained)
- [CLAM](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/clam.html): Weakly supervised whole-slide classification (GPL-3.0; Stale)
- [UNI](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/uni.html): Pathology foundation model (Nature Medicine) (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; Stale)
- [QuPath](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/qupath.html): Open-source bioimage and whole-slide analysis (GPL-3.0; Maintained)

## Clinical NLP

- [Apache cTAKES](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/apache-ctakes.html): NLP platform for clinical text (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [medspaCy](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medspacy.html): Clinical NLP library built on spaCy (MIT; Maintained)
- [scispaCy](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/scispacy.html): spaCy pipelines and models for biomedical text (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [QuickUMLS](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/quickumls.html): Medical concept extraction and UMLS linking (MIT; Stale)

## EHR & data

- [HAPI FHIR](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/hapi-fhir.html): Java API for HL7 FHIR clients and servers (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [Synthea](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/synthea.html): Synthetic patient population simulator (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [MIMIC code](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/mimic-code.html): Community code for the MIMIC databases (MIT; Maintained)
- [OHDSI ATLAS](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/ohdsi-atlas.html): Web tool for observational analyses on OMOP data (Apache-2.0; Maintained)
- [OHDSI WhiteRabbit](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/ohdsi-whiterabbit.html): Profiles source databases to plan ETL into OMOP (Apache-2.0; Maintained)

## DICOM datasets

- [B-mode-and-CEUS-Liver](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/b-mode-and-ceus-liver/): Focal liver lesions on B-mode and contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [BrainMetShare](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/1emj-bjxt3p6s0): Brain metastases with radiologist segmentations on a subset (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals no; Check source; VERIFIED)
- [Breast-Cancer-Screening-DBT (BCS-DBT)](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/breast-cancer-screening-dbt/): Screening digital breast tomosynthesis, with cancer cases and normal/benign exams (CC BY-NC 4.0; access open; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Burdenko-GBM-Progression](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/burdenko-gbm-progression/): Glioblastoma radiotherapy planning and follow-up, with RTSTRUCT/RTDOSE/RTPLAN (NIH Controlled Data Access Policy (images); CC BY 4.0 (clinical and genomic CSV); access credentialed; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [C4KC-KiTS](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/c4kc-kits/): Kidney tumors (KiTS) with segmentations (CC BY 3.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [CBIS-DDSM](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/cbis-ddsm/): Curated mammography masses and calcifications, benign and malignant (CC BY 3.0; access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [CFB-GBM](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/cfb-gbm/): Glioblastoma, with pre- and post-treatment MRI, planning CT, RTDOSE, tumor masks, and GTV (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [CheXpert Plus](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/5yyj-1a9f6ap0x): Chest radiographs with full reports and 14 CheXpert pathology labels, including studies without those findings (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [CMMD](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/cmmd/): Chinese mammography dataset with benign and malignant cases and molecular subtypes (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [COCA](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/1vm9-30b7p5srg): Coronary artery calcium on gated coronary CT and non-gated chest CT (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Colorectal-Liver-Metastases](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/colorectal-liver-metastases/): Colorectal liver metastases with segmentations (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [CPAISD](https://zenodo.org/records/10892316): Hyperacute ischemic stroke on non-contrast head CT, with core and penumbra outlines (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [CQ500](https://academictorrents.com/details/47e9d8aab761e75fd0a81982fa62bddf3a173831): Non-contrast head CT with radiologist reads for critical findings (hemorrhage, fracture, and others) (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [CT Colonography](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/ct-colonography/): CT colonography with and without colorectal neoplasia (CC BY 3.0 and CC BY 4.0 (see the file table); access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [CT-ICH](https://physionet.org/content/ct-ich/): Traumatic brain injury head CT with hemorrhage masks and slice labels; some scans have no hemorrhage (PhysioNet Restricted Health Data License 1.5.0; access credentialed; normals partial; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [CT-ORG](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/ct-org/): CT with liver lesions and metastases, labeled for lung, bone, liver, kidney, and bladder (CC BY 3.0; access open; normals no; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [Duke-Breast-Cancer-MRI](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/duke-breast-cancer-mri/): Invasive breast cancer MRI with segmentations, radiomics, and outcomes (CC BY-NC 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [EchoNet-Dynamic](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/66s1-2hsmzj5rn): Echocardiogram videos with ejection-fraction labels and tracings, across a range of function (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; video; VERIFIED)
- [FDG-PET-CT-Lesions (autoPET)](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/fdg-pet-ct-lesions/): Whole-body FDG-PET/CT in lymphoma, melanoma, and NSCLC, plus studies with no PET-positive malignancy (CC BY 4.0 (defaced images and clinical CSV); NIH Controlled Data Access Policy (original images); access open; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Healthy-Total-Body-CTs](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/healthy-total-body-cts/): Healthy adult total-body low-dose CT from the uEXPLORER PET/CT scanner, with organ segmentations (NIH Controlled Data Access Policy (CT images); CC BY 4.0 (organ segmentations and demographics); access credentialed; normals yes; DICOM; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [INSPECT](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/2n96-d71hggrbf): Pulmonary embolism cohort with CT, report sections, and structured EHR (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals no; Check source; VERIFIED)
- [ISLES'24](https://zenodo.org/records/16970401): Acute ischemic stroke with admission CT/CTA/CTP and follow-up MRI infarct masks (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; access open; normals no; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [IXI](https://brain-development.org/ixi-dataset/): Normal, healthy adult brain MRI (T1, T2, PD, MRA, diffusion) (CC BY-SA 3.0; access open; normals yes; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [LERA](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/0jyf-46kmqh2vf): Lower-extremity radiographs (foot, knee, ankle, or hip) (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; Check source; VERIFIED)
- [LIDC-IDRI](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/lidc-idri/): Lung nodules marked by four readers; includes nodules that were not cancer (CC BY 3.0; access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Merlin Abdominal CT](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/exfv-e8h3kvfhs): Emergency abdominal and pelvic CT paired with report findings (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [MIDRC](https://data.midrc.org/): Medical imaging, especially chest and COVID-era collections, with clinical data and reports where contributors included them (University of Chicago data-use agreement (non-commercial research by default; a separate commercial agreement exists); access credentialed; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [MIDRC-RICORD (1A, 1B, 1C)](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/midrc-ricord-1a/): COVID-19 chest CT and radiography, with non-COVID controls in 1B and 1C (CC BY-NC 4.0; access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [MIMIC-CXR](https://physionet.org/content/mimic-cxr/): Emergency and inpatient chest radiographs with free-text reports, across many findings and no-finding studies (PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0; access credentialed; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [MRNet](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/4a2c-4cpkzrn2c): Knee MRI exams labeled for abnormality, ACL tear, and meniscal tear (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; NumPy; VERIFIED)
- [MURA](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/cv1a-apytk3j44): Musculoskeletal radiographs labeled normal or abnormal (elbow, finger, forearm, hand, humerus, shoulder, wrist) (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals yes; PNG/JPEG; VERIFIED)
- [NCI Imaging Data Commons](https://portal.imaging.datacommons.cancer.gov/collections/): Many cancer collections (TCGA, TCIA, CPTAC, NLST, LIDC, and others), harmonized to DICOM (Mostly CC BY; a minority of files are CC-NC (each file is tagged); access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [NLST (TCIA imaging subset)](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/nlst/): Lung-cancer screening low-dose CT, mostly without cancer, plus cancer cases (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Open POCUS](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/9e5t-a8ppjpsfd): Lung point-of-care ultrasound, including clips with no abnormality, B-lines, and consolidation (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; video; VERIFIED)
- [OpenNeuro](https://openneuro.org/): Many brain MRI studies, including healthy controls and disease cohorts, in BIDS (Per dataset, usually CC0 after a 36-month grace period (check source); access open; normals partial; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [Pancreas-CT](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/pancreas-ct/): Healthy / non-cancer abdominal CT with pancreas segmentations (CC BY 3.0; access open; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Pedi-Cranial-CT-Healthy](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/pedi-cranial-ct-healthy/): Healthy pediatric cranial CT (normative) (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals yes; MHA; VERIFIED)
- [Pediatric-CT-SEG](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/pediatric-ct-seg/): Routine pediatric chest-abdomen-pelvis or abdomen-pelvis CT with expert organ contours (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Prostate-MRI-US-Biopsy](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/prostate-mri-us-biopsy/): Prostate MRI and ultrasound fusion biopsy, including benign biopsy results (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [PSMA-PET-CT-Lesions](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/psma-pet-ct-lesions/): PSMA PET/CT in prostate cancer with lesion segmentations (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [QIN-SARCOMA](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/qin-sarcoma/): Soft-tissue sarcoma DCE-MRI, before and during preoperative chemoradiation (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [ReMIND (preoperative MRI and intraoperative ultrasound)](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/remind/): Brain tumors treated with resection, including intraoperative ultrasound (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [RSNA 2022 Cervical Spine Fracture Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-2022-cervical-spine-fracture-detection): Cervical spine fractures on CT, including studies without fracture (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [RSNA 2023 Abdominal Trauma Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-2023-abdominal-trauma-detection): Traumatic abdominal injury on CT, including exams without injury (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [RSNA 2024 Lumbar Spine Degenerative Classification](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-2024-lumbar-spine-degenerative-classification): Lumbar spine degenerative findings on MRI (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-intracranial-aneurysm-detection): Intracranial aneurysms on brain CT, including studies without an aneurysm (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [RSNA Intracranial Hemorrhage Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-intracranial-hemorrhage-detection): Acute intracranial hemorrhage subtypes on head CT, including exams without hemorrhage (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-pneumonia-detection-challenge): Lung opacities concerning for pneumonia on chest radiographs, including exams without opacity (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [RSNA Screening Mammography Breast Cancer Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-breast-cancer-detection): Screening mammography with cancer and non-cancer exams (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [RSNA-MICCAI Brain Tumor Radiogenomic Classification](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-miccai-brain-tumor-radiogenomic-classification): Glioma MRI labeled for MGMT promoter methylation (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [RSNA-STR Pulmonary Embolism Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-str-pulmonary-embolism-detection): Pulmonary embolism on CT pulmonary angiography, including negative studies (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax Segmentation](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/siim-acr-pneumothorax-segmentation): Pneumothorax on chest radiographs, with masks, including exams without pneumothorax (Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); access account; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Soft-tissue-Sarcoma](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/soft-tissue-sarcoma/): Extremity soft-tissue sarcoma with FDG-PET/CT and MRI (CC BY 3.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [SPADe](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/ddvj-f3019dwey): Whole-body FDG-PET/CT for abnormality detection (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals no; Check source; VERIFIED)
- [Spine-Mets-CT-SEG](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/spine-mets-ct-seg/): Spinal metastases with vertebral and lesion segmentations (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Sunnybrook Cardiac Data](https://sourceforge.net/projects/cardiac-mr/files/): Cine cardiac MRI: healthy, hypertrophy, heart failure with infarction, and heart failure without infarction (CC0 1.0; access open; normals partial; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Thyroid Ultrasound Cine-clip](https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/2n5z-4m99zdpyp): Biopsy-confirmed thyroid nodules with cine clips, segmentations, and TI-RADS descriptors (Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals no; video; VERIFIED)
- [UCSD-BMETS-Longitudinal](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/ucsd-bmets-longitudinal/): Brain metastases, longitudinal pre- and post-treatment MRI with neuroradiologist-approved segmentations (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [UPENN-GBM](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/upenn-gbm/): Newly diagnosed glioblastoma, with segmentations and clinical/genomic tables (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; NIfTI; VERIFIED)
- [Vestibular-Schwannoma-MC-RC](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/vestibular-schwannoma-mc-rc/): Sporadic vestibular schwannoma, longitudinal MRI from multiple UK sites (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [Vestibular-Schwannoma-SEG](https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/vestibular-schwannoma-seg/): Vestibular schwannoma treated with Gamma Knife, with contours (CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; DICOM; VERIFIED)
- [VinDr-CXR](https://physionet.org/content/vindr-cxr/): Adult chest radiographs with radiologist bounding boxes and image-level diagnoses, including no-finding exams (PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0; access credentialed; normals yes; DICOM; VERIFIED)
